Game Overview

At its heart, Kei Superwoman is a adventure game about leap into action as Kei, the fearless heroine in a side-scrolling, burger-collecting adventure. Master the art of double jumping to navigate perilous traps and enemies across eight progressively challenging levels. Unravel the perfect path, save the day, and let no obstacle stand in your way!

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Kei Superwoman is easy to pick up. Leap into action as Kei, the fearless heroine in a side-scrolling, burger-collecting adventure. Master the art of double jumping to navigate perilous traps and enemies across eight progressively challenging levels. Unravel the perfect path, save the day, and let no obstacle stand in your way!
